title: 落魄画师逆袭 · 第一集
what_if: 一个被同学嘲笑的落魄画师，其实竟是 M 国顶级富豪。
target_feeling: 爽感 + 反转 + 打脸
visual_style: cinematic photorealistic 3D render, warm tungsten interior light, shallow depth of field, film grain

characters.name: 陈锋
characters.identity_note: male 32, lean build, black tousled hair, worn grey hoodie over a plain tee, paint-stained fingertips, calm confident posture; do-not-change: face, haircut, grey hoodie

characters.name: 王总
characters.identity_note: male 45, heavy set, slicked hair, loud red silk shirt, gold chain, smug posture; do-not-change: face, red silk shirt

scenes.name: 同学聚会餐厅
scenes.description: upscale restaurant, round table, warm chandeliers, night, other guests blurred in background
scenes.light_baseline: key: warm overhead chandelier, fill: soft bounce, mood: slightly smug

shots.continuity_handoff: Open on Wang's smug close-up; sets up Chen as the target of mockery for the next shot.
shots.lighting_baseline: key: warm overhead chandelier, fill: soft bounce
shots.shot_description: medium close-up of Wang leaning back, sneering at someone off-frame; table chatter blurs behind.

per_second.action: Wang leans back, gold chain sways, smug smile
per_second.spatial: Wang center, chandelier top, table bottom

per_second.action: Chen's shoulder + back of grey hoodie enter frame-left
per_second.spatial: Chen left third, Wang right third

dialogue.text: 就这？画个画糊口，也好意思坐我们这桌？

references.label: <Picture 1>
references.retention_note: retain face + grey hoodie of Chen
references.description: the man in the worn grey hoodie, paint-stained fingertips

shots.continuity_handoff: Chen turns from Wang's mockery; same table/landmarks; his calm face reveals the reversal is coming.
shots.lighting_baseline: key: warm overhead, fill: soft bounce; modifier: Chen rim-lit by chandelier
shots.shot_description: Chen turns slowly, unbothered, a faint smile; Wang's smug cracks.

per_second.action: Chen turns head toward camera, calm
Wang leans forward confused, smug breaks
Chen raises one hand, slow, controlled
per_second.spatial: hand center, phone not yet shown

dialogue.text: 坐下。我打个电话，你们就懂了我为什么不来。

references.label: <Picture 1>
references.retention_note: retain face + grey hoodie of Chen
references.description: the man in the worn grey hoodie

shots.continuity_handoff: Phone connects; cut on the moment of the 'click' to the reveal — the strong closing hook.
shots.lighting_baseline: key: warm overhead; modifier: screen glow on Wang's face
shots.shot_description: The phone connects to a head office; an operator's voice over the loudspeaker; Wang goes pale; end on the reveal.

per_second.action: Chen holds phone to speaker, calm
per_second.audio: phone connect tone + operator voice 'Mr. Chen, the M Group board awaits your return'

per_second.action: Wang's face drains of colour, hand drops
Chen lowers phone, looks at camera, faint smile
per_second.spatial: Chen center, Wang small in background
per_second.audio: operator 'we will arrange the jet' + music sting
per_second.handoff: end on Chen's confident close-up + sting

dialogue.text: 陈先生，M 集团董事会等您回来主持，专机正在安排。
